title: Advanced SELECT [JOIN (LEFT)]
description:
## The Problem
In the last lesson, Alice had no deployments. INNER JOIN only returns rows where BOTH tables have a match - so Alice disappeared from the results.

## LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN keeps ALL rows from the left table (the first one), even if there's no match in the right table. Unmatched columns show up as `NULL`.
```sql
SELECT t1.r1, t2.r2
FROM t1
LEFT JOIN t2
    ON t1.id = t2.t1_id;
```

### Visual:
```
INNER JOIN:  Only where both match
  Steve -> BWS-API       ✓
  Bob   -> Bread tracker ✓
  Alice -> ???           ✗ (gone!)

LEFT JOIN:   Keep all from left table
  Steve -> BWS-API       ✓
  Bob   -> Bread tracker ✓
  Alice -> NULL          ✓ (still here!)
```

---
## Assignment:
BWS needs a report of ALL users and their deployments. Users with no deployments should still appear. Show each user's name and their deployment app name. Order it by users.id
setupCode: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE deployments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, app TEXT NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, status TEXT); INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'Steve'), (2, 'Bob'), (3, 'Alice'); INSERT INTO deployments VALUES (1, 'BWS-API', 1, 'running'), (2, 'Bread tracker', 2, 'on fire'), (3, 'StupidShovelware', 1, 'deleted');
